data.name: Goal Gang
data.detailed_description:
Goal Gang is online multiplayer football built for pure chaos. Take control of a single player and jump into intense action where teamwork wins games until everything breaks loose.

BATTLE FOR THE BALL

Winning takes more than goals. It requires total control of the pitch. Use physics-based hits to clear your path, reclaim the ball, and trigger game-changing modifiers. Between massive teammates and explosive power-ups, you must adapt quickly or lose your spot on the field.

PLAY TOGETHER, ANYWHERE

Coordinate with your squad to master the field. Use skill-based controls to curve shots, time tackles, and execute celebrations that rub it in. With full cross-platform support, you can crush your friends on PC, mobile, or web.

FLEX ON THE FIELD

Style is a stat. Choose from a massive library of outfits and emotes to look the part when the whistle blows. If you aren't winning with a ridiculous mop of hair, are you even winning?

FEATURES

  • Chaotic Multiplayer: Fast-paced online matches for up to 18 players.

  • Physics-First Gameplay: Real-time collisions and ball mechanics. Zero scripted outcomes.

  • Wild Modifiers: Match-changing powers that keep every round unpredictable.

  • Total Customization: Countless outfits, skins, and emotes to build your brand.

  • Full Cross-Play: Compete across PC, mobile, and web.

  • Global Leaderboards: Rise from local scrub to world-class star.

  • Social Play: Integrated voice chat with public and private servers.

Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 | AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7750 | NVIDIA Geforce GTX 260
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
